evals.name: fixture-loads-and-describes-purpose
evals.description: Sanity check that this fixture skill is discoverable and its SKILL.md is well-formed.
evals.prompt: Describe the purpose of the model-triggered-fixture skill.
evals.expected: The response should explain that this is a test fixture used by skill-artisan's own test suite as the model-triggered control case, not a real user-facing skill.

evals.name: export-workflow-described
evals.description: Checks the skill's two-step export workflow is represented accurately.
evals.prompt: What does the model-triggered-fixture skill do, step by step?
evals.expected: The response should mention reading fixture data and writing a formatted report to disk.

evals.name: trigger-context-present
evals.description: Checks the fixture's description carries real trigger-context framing, since it's the control case for normal (non-disable-model-invocation) trigger-optimization guidance.
evals.prompt: When should the model-triggered-fixture skill be used?
evals.expected: The response should reference exporting fixture data to a formatted report, matching the skill's 'Use when...' description.
